title: Source-Faithful, Output-First Quality

local: fresh local browser generation and output audit

ciFast.note: Remote exact-commit verification begins after this locally verified candidate is pushed.

ciDeep.note: No new model-quality, adapter, or external-provider comparison claim is made before remote evidence exists.

deploy.note: Production deployment and exact-version re-audit are downstream of push and remote verification.

liveProvider.note: The browser proof uses the shipped browser-local Scion runtime; it does not claim a fresh external-provider package.

manualHuman.note: No instructor evaluation, accessibility certification, or classroom validation is claimed.

claims.summary: Named assessment artifacts and final-project components persist from the authored week contract into assignments and rubrics.
Compiler-inferred assessment weight is bounded and recovery quizzes include the exact practice case their questions use.
Public-health source admission, repetition repair, artifact-label repair, and review-ZIP labeling make output findings visible and actionable.

boundaries: This contract records a locally verified predeploy candidate; remote CI, production deployment, and live re-audit are downstream facts.
Course-created recovery practice remains labeled practice evidence and does not become an external factual source.
The patch changes deterministic source-contract, compiler, export, and review behavior; it changes no model weights or adapter promotion state.
